subject: Converge Meter Economy Pay Finance and Ledger without erasing their named Power identities

body.text: The older named finance/value Powers expose a concrete parallel-ownership cluster that now conflicts with the mature FinancialMetabolism/Institutional Economy model. Repository evidence: BonfyreMeter owns an events table, computes op cost from hard-coded tariffs and can generate invoices; BonfyreEconomy owns separate budgets/costs/routes, embeds static model prices and treats local as $0; BonfyrePay owns another invoice/payment/credit database plus another pricing table and currently simulates meter usage; BonfyreFinance owns service/job/bundle prices and costs; BonfyreLedger computes replacement_cost_usd/portfolio_value_usd from heuristic constants. Do not delete or flatten these named Powers. Converge ownership: Meter becomes a UsageOccurrence measurement/query surface; Economy becomes budget/route policy over canonical EconomicMeasure + ProviderGraph with versioned evidence and unknown local monetary cost unless measured; Pay becomes invoice/payment/reconciliation projection over canonical FinancialEvent/agreements rather than simulated pricing; Finance remains service/business arbitrage and bundle-pricing domain logic, distinct from provider billing; Ledger remains artifact valuation/scenario estimation with declared assumptions. Preserve public CLI compatibility through the semantic Shell/Fabric owner paths, migrate any useful retained rows with source/evidence tags, and ensure no legacy sqlite store silently outranks canonical finance. Prove the same economic/financial occurrence is addressable from the relevant named Power and FinancialMetabolism without duplicate money facts.
